subject: Banking
title: Payday Loans: Legal Loan Sharking
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Payday Loans: Legal Loan Sharking.

hook.text: Payday loans charge $15-30 per $100 borrowed for two weeks. That equals an annual rate of 400-780%. Legal loan sharking.

buildup.text: 12 million Americans use payday loans annually. The average borrower takes 8 loans per year.

discovery.text: Payday lenders cluster in low-income and minority neighborhoods.

twist.text: 80% of payday loans are rolled over into new loans. The borrower never pays off the principal, just the fees.

climax.text: Payday lending is a $9 billion industry built on trapping poor people in cycles of debt.

punchline.text: 400-780% APR. More shops than McDonald's. Legal debt traps for the poor.

quiz.question: What is the effective annual interest rate on payday loans?
